raw: {"analysis":"Response MQZ correctly treats the 30-minute CI timeout as a hard constraint that must be solved by optimizing the test suite, explicitly forbidding the current problematic manual-retry pattern. Response SPX proposes sharding but then suggests marking timeouts as 'Warn' and allowing manual retries by the Platform Team—essentially perpetuating the exact false-failure problem the repository facts describe. MQZ also provides clearer gate definitions and properly sequences the Support Widget's static fallback generation within its build process, while SPX's phased rollout (merging Support Widget first) introduces unnecessary coordination risk given the train-merge nature of the dependency chain.","verdict":"MQZ"}
